title: Chander Kunj Army Towers: apartment owners call for appointment of project officer amid demolition delays

It also demands that the District Collector’s committee and the subcommittee chaired by the Fort Kochi Revenue Divisional Officer be convened at the earliest to oversee the demolition and reconstruction of the apartments.

title: When home in Delhi became a death trap: Satya Niketan building collapse
content: The collapse of a five-storey building in Delhi’s Satya Niketan on September 6 killed seven people. The incident has exposed the precarious housing conditions for students in the capital, where the demand for affordable accommodation far outstrips the availability of institutional hostels. Lavpreet Kaur reports on the rescue and the questions being raised over the safety of paying guest accommodation

content: Around 60 lakh flood affected people served meals; river levels recede further. 1221 community kitchens currently operational in various districts.

content: "The world is always changing, and this is attested to by the objective facts of the last five years," Valdimir Putin said at the BRICS Business Forum.

title: Delhi Lt Governor Proposes Mandatory Tuberculosis Test For All Hospital Patients
content: The proposal comes as Delhi is behind key targets under its TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, with the September 30 deadline approaching.

title: Israeli Army "Categorically Rejects" Alleged AI Use In Targeting Gazans
content: The Israeli-made film "NAZA" uses conversations with 24 different Israeli military or intelligence whistleblowers who spoke on condition that their identities be protected, with interviewees describing how they felt like they worked in a killing "factory" or a lethal video game.

title: UK Man Pleads Guilty To Encouraging Sexual Abuse Of Drugged Women
content: It is the latest in a string of UK criminal cases involving men accused of abusing their partners while asleep or sedated and often going on to share images of their offences.

title: After Trump renames Lake Ontario, Republican wants Lake Erie renamed too
content: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal agencies to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America” on US maps, documents and databases. Canada has rejected the move, while several US governors have also said they will continue calling it Lake Ontario. The decision comes amid rising trade tensions between Washington and Ottawa.

title: Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars
content: Tesla's new Cybercab robotaxis are now operating in Texas without traditional controls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an audit of these vehicles. US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. Experts suggest Tesla may challenge regulatory interpretations to deploy its vehicles.

title: 'Future captain, maybe?': Ishan Kishan's banter with Vaibhav Sooryavanshi goes viral - WATCH
content: Ishan Kishan had a memorable final, scoring more than 350 runs across the two innings, including a stunning 270 in the first innings, and was named Player of the Match. Kishan and 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi shared a fun moment after East Zone’s memorable Duleep Trophy 2026/27 triumph.

title: SC's 13 queries to FSSAI: 'Give details on shape, size, colour of food label'
content: The Supreme Court has mandated that the FSSAI outline precise details about food warning labels, including their design, dimensions, colors, and position on food packaging. Additionally, the court emphasizes the importance of communicating junk food risks to children. FSSAI is tasked with addressing thirteen specific inquiries within ten days, noting while progress has been made, more detailed clarification is still necessary.

title: Zverev beats Khachanov, reaches US Open final and eyes second major of year
content: Alexander Zverev battled his way to the US Open final, showcasing resilience in a gripping match. Having triumphed at the French Open earlier this year, he now faces an American in the championship, a historic moment as the U.S. has lacked a men's Grand Slam champion since 2003. This final is a crucial chance for Zverev to cement his legacy with another prestigious title.

title: Countries where you can buy iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cheaper than India
content: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models have officially launched worldwide.  These devices feature the powerful A20 Pro chip and improved camera technology.  Pricing for these flagship iPhones varies considerably across different countries.  The United States offers the most affordable purchase option for both models.  India's pricing reflects higher local taxes and import duties on electronics.

title: Israel released 28 wild donkeys in desert; 44 years later, they created an oasis
content: In an effort to rejuvenate the parched landscape of Israel's Ramon Crater, wild donkeys were brought back into the ecosystem. These resilient animals played a crucial role by creating waterholes, which became essential for desert wildlife. Additionally, their droppings helped spread acacia seeds, promoting the growth of trees. Their natural movements resulted in water-retaining depressions, significantly transforming the area's ecology into a thriving environment that has caught global attention.

title: GPS collars revealed male lions follow hyenas, not the other way around
content: A groundbreaking study suggests that it's the male lions that approach spotted hyenas, contrary to the belief that hyenas seek out lion remains for food. In fact, spotted hyenas are known to back away from lions, prioritizing their safety. This finding highlights the importance of spatial avoidance in hyena behavior, emphasizing their adaptive strategies to circumvent confrontations with such powerful hunters.

title: Microsoft signs 'iron-clad' student privacy deal with teachers unions after NYC AI ban
content: Microsoft has signed a legally binding AI privacy agreement with the American Federation of Teachers and United Federation of Teachers, a week after Zohran Mamdani banned AI in NYC schools. The standard bars Microsoft from training AI on student data, tracking students or offering AI companion chatbots. School districts can cancel contracts over violations. Los Angeles Unified has paused student AI use, while unions want OpenAI and Anthropic to sign next.

title: 'Allow easy movement to professionals': Piyush Goyal urges Brics states
content: Piyush Goyal urged Brics nations to dismantle trade barriers and open markets. He also called for linking payment systems and trading in local currencies. Streamlining customs and promoting services trade were also highlighted by the minister. External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar emphasized transparent trade and investment practices. The goal is to foster business partnerships and market access for member nations.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35M mansion: Why are neighbors worried about lake views?
content: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million waterfront mansion in Bratenahl, Ohio, has faced an unexpected neighborhood dispute over proposed fencing. Some residents reportedly worried the original plans could interfere with their Lake Erie views, leading to discussions with neighbors. A section of the fence extending toward the beach was later scrapped. Despite the disagreement, local officials have welcomed Kelce, while emphasizing the importance of both community ties and privacy.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s $6.7M estate: Why did his Cheshire mansion lose value?
content: Cristiano Ronaldo’s former Cheshire estate was listed for about $7.4 million in 2023 but later saw its asking price fall to $6.7 million. The 23-acre property has a seven-bedroom mansion, indoor pool, gym, cinema, tennis and padel courts. Ronaldo moved there after returning to Manchester United but later relocated before leaving England for Al-Nassr.

title: 'Haiwaan' opens at Rs 3 crore amid 'Hanuman Ansh' and 'Mirzapur' wave
content: Haiwaan, starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, opened with a modest Rs 3 crore net collection. The film's opening day performance ranks among the lower openings for both leading actors. Strong competition from 'Hanuman Ansh' and 'Mirzapur The Movie' impacted Haiwaan's box office run. 'Hanuman Ansh' continues its phenomenal hold, earning Rs 10.50 crore on its sixth Friday.

title: Russia unveils new S-71K stealth missile for Su-57E amid potential sale to India
content: Russia has disclosed its latest S-71K Kovyor air-launched weapon designed specifically for the Su-57E fighter jet. This advanced system integrates the capabilities of both cruise missiles and drones, enabling effective stand-off attacks. With enhanced stealth features and cost-effectiveness for broader operational deployment, Russia is actively engaging India in discussions about potential joint production and technology transfer related to the Su-57E and its cutting-edge armaments.

title: Women's Asia Cup: Sri Lanka fight back from 33/4 to beat Pakistan, set up India final
content: Sri Lanka emerged victorious in a dramatic four-wicket win against Pakistan during the Women's Asia Cup semi-final. Despite a rocky start, they rallied impressively to chase down the target. Fatima Sana, Pakistan's captain, delivered a commendable performance, yet her efforts fell short. This thrilling victory sets the stage for Sri Lanka to challenge India in the forthcoming tournament finale.

title: Tharoor answers Chidambaram’s questions on Brics benefits for India; BJP takes digs
content: Shashi Tharoor defended India's BRICS summit prestige in contrast to Chidambaram's questions on its tangible benefits. The BJP criticized Chidambaram's remarks and highlighted Tharoor's differing viewpoint. Tharoor stated hosting leaders shows diplomatic convening power and value. He also noted BRICS represents a majority of the world's population. Tharoor's independent views often create internal Congress party discussions.

title: Pakistan mount stunning fightback, force tricky chase for England at Edgbaston
content: Day 3 of the third Test brought a thrilling turn of events as Pakistan demonstrated their resilience with a phenomenal 449 runs in their second innings, spanning nearly 97 overs. This left England with a target of just 130 runs to clinch the series. The highlight was a crucial 121-run partnership for the ninth wicket that stifled England's bowling attack, setting the stage for an exciting Day 4 showdown.

title: Bigg Boss 20: Qazi Touqeer on his bond with Arijit Singh; ‘Woh Crazypan Ka Baap Hai'
content: Qazi Touqeer, a contestant on Bigg Boss, reminisced about his long-standing friendship with the talented singer Arijit Singh, whom he first met on a singing reality show two decades ago. With great admiration, Touqeer honored Singh's artistry by performing 'Tum Hi Ho' during a recent episode. In a heartwarming gesture, Arijit Singh revealed his intention to tune in to Bigg Boss exclusively to support Touqeer.

title: Houthi advances puts India and global trade closer to the edge
content: Houthi forces are close to seizing control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, crucial for global shipping. This advance heightens concerns over trade security and energy supply chains around the world. India could experience rising costs and extended transit times for its goods. The Houthis are also enhancing their military capabilities, including integrating AI into weapons systems. This development poses new geopolitical challenges, especially for Pakistan and its defense alliances.

title: Instead of managing billions, Warren Buffett’s son Howard Buffett chose farming
content: Choosing a path less traveled, Howard Buffett, the son of Warren Buffett, dedicated his life to farming and conservation rather than finance. He skillfully managed farms in Nebraska and Illinois, prioritizing soil health. Warren Buffett supported his passion by purchasing a Nebraska farm for his son. As he transitions to the role of non-executive chairman at Berkshire Hathaway, Howard aims to safeguard the company’s culture following his father's legacy.

title: Mumbai mall entry case: Man used ChatGPT to create fake PMO docs, police tell court
content: A 24-year-old man was arrested for impersonating a PMO official at Jio World Plaza. He allegedly used ChatGPT to create fake PMO documents and an identity card. Police seized electronic devices and documents from his residence in Khar. His private security guard, an ex-Army personnel, was also arrested with a firearm. Both accused have been remanded to judicial custody by the court.

title: In Noida’s PG belt, buildings rise nine floors where two are allowed
content: Densely packed multi-storey paying guest accommodations have been built illegally in Noida villages. These structures often lack essential fire safety and emergency exits, posing significant risks. Many buildings violate building codes, with thin columns and narrow lanes hindering access for emergency services. Demand for affordable housing from students and IT professionals drives this rampant, unsafe construction. Tenants prioritize affordability over documented safety measures in their accommodation choices.

title: Lessons from Ukraine war: Poland wants its own Starlink; where does India stand?
content: Poland is set to collaborate with Finnish firm ICEYE to establish a new military satellite communications system, aiming to lessen its dependency on foreign entities for vital battlefield communications. This project is projected to unfold between 2026 and 2030, incorporating local industrial partners. Meanwhile, India has had robust military satellite communication capabilities for over ten years, recently enhancing its maritime surveillance with the launch of CMS-03.

title: 'We will never, ever forget': Trump commemorates 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
content: On the anniversary of 9/11, leaders across the United States honored the victims and reflected on the impact of the tragedy on current foreign policy. Speaking at the Pentagon, President Trump paid homage to the fallen and reaffirmed the nation’s determination, particularly in its dealings with Iran. Defense Secretary Hegseth reinforced this message, relating the historical attacks to the ongoing war on terror.

title: ‘His time will come’: Rahane wants Sooryavanshi to wait as Samson returns
content: Ajinkya Rahane expresses his enthusiastic support for Sanju Samson's reentry into India's batting lineup, asserting the importance of maintaining their World Cup-winning squad for the upcoming Afghanistan series. In a recent video, Rahane encouraged young talent Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to trust in his instincts and play freely, while highlighting the need for mental resilience to bolster his career growth.

title: Days before 9/11, businessman took Twin Towers' lease; now, the rebuilding nears end
content: The final commercial office tower at the World Trade Center site is actively being built as the new global headquarters for American Express. This project has emerged after extensive planning and has navigated numerous hurdles. It acts as a tribute to the lives lost and rekindles commercial activity in Lower Manhattan, representing a crucial milestone in the comprehensive post-9/11 redevelopment plan.

title: UP man stalks, stabs teen in neck after she rejects his advances; arrested
content: An Agra man was arrested after stabbing a nineteen-year-old woman. He attacked her on her way to work after she rejected his advances. The woman was rushed to a hospital for treatment of her wounds. Police apprehended the accused near the JCB Ground after receiving information. The sharp object used in the crime was reportedly thrown into a river.

title: 20 runs in 6 innings: Pak openers register worst Test series in 35 years vs England
content: In a dismal display, Pakistan's opening batsmen faltered throughout their recent Test series against England, accumulating a mere twenty runs across six partnerships. This represented the team's worst performance in thirty-five years, with no partnership exceeding ten runs. Despite the collective shortcomings, Azan Awais managed to find some consistency, although his partners repeatedly fell victim to batting collapses, highlighted by a first innings disaster at Edgbaston.

title: 80 lakh HPV vaccine doses given since February launch
content:
This marks a major step in cervical caner prevention

- New Delhi: India has crossed the 80 lakh mark in human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination under the national campaign since its launch in Feb 2026, marking a major step in cervical cancer prevention. The campaign provides free, voluntary, single-dose HPV vaccination to 14-year-old girls, with parental consent, at govt health facilities. Around 1.2 crore 14-year-old girls are expected to benefit from the initiative. Uttar Pradesh leads with over 22 lakh vaccinations, while Gujarat and Mizoram have achieved 100% coverage. Bihar and Assam have crossed 90%, Karnataka 85%, and Chhattisgarh, Sikkim, Kerala, Telangana and Odisha 60%.
